required_needles: cannot fail is not a suite

phases.title: Make the test harness capable of failing
phases.finding: src/testing/harness.rs:execute_test_code() returns Ok(()) unless the code fails to parse or throws, so a Redblue test can only fail by crashing - no assertion is ever evaluated. src/testing/assertions.rs (19 assertion fns) is dead code, reachable only via `pub use assertions::*` in testing/mod.rs:6. Verified deeper than first recorded: Expr::Expect is declared at parser.rs:56 but there is NO construction site anywhere in parser.rs, so the `expect A to be B` form does not merely go unasserted, it fails to parse - ParserError: Unexpected token Expect. `rb test` reports 0 tests because every .rb file in tests/ is 100% commented out and discovery only matches lines starting `// test `.
phases.goal: Make the `expect A to be B` form parse, evaluate, and FAIL the test on mismatch - so a Redblue test is capable of failing at all.
accept: parser.rs constructs Expr::Expect for the xpect A to be B form
harness.rs evaluates Expr::Expect and returns TestAssertionError on mismatch
assertions.rs is called from the harness, not dead code
a deliberately WRONG test (expect 1 to be 2) is observed to FAIL, with a message naming both values
a correct test (expect 1 to be 1) PASSES
cargo test proves both directions

phases.title: Fix test discovery: stop feeding Rust source to the Redblue harness
phases.finding: src/testing/mod.rs:run_all_tests() scans tests/ for BOTH `.rs` and `.rb`, so tests/redblue_test.rs (Rust source) is parsed as Redblue code and reported as a failure. Discovery also requires lines starting with `// test `.
phases.goal: Separate the two suites. Rust tests run under cargo test; only `.rb` files go through the Redblue harness.
accept: run_all_tests() only collects .rb
rb test reports 0 errors for the Rust suite
no .rs path is ever read by the Redblue harness

phases.title: Write a real Redblue test suite
phases.finding: tests/suite.rb, tests/integration_test.rb, tests/test_arithmetic.rb are 100% commented out. The repo's entire Redblue-language test suite is zero tests.
phases.goal: Replace the commented placeholders with real, assertion-bearing `test` blocks covering arithmetic, text, lists, records, control flow, functions, objects, modules.
accept: >= 40 Redblue test blocks, all with assertions
>= 8 named edge_*
>= 5 tests that assert a failure is produced
cargo test and rb test both green, non-zero counts

phases.title: Deterministic Record ordering
phases.finding: src/value.rs:11 Record(HashMap<String, Value>) and Value::Display (value.rs:34-40) iterate the map, so `say` and `json.stringify` on a record emit keys in random order per process.
phases.goal: Preserve insertion order for records and objects.
accept: record display order is stable across processes
json.stringify round-trips and is stable
edge test: 20-key record prints in insertion order, run 50x, identical
duplicate-key last-wins semantics tested

phases.title: Source spans on every error
phases.finding: src/error.rs carries only String. Parser errors like `Error::Parser("Unexpected token ...")` give no file, line or column, unlike the lexer which already tracks line/column.
phases.goal: Attach file:line:col to Parser, Analyzer and Runtime errors and render a caret diagnostic.
accept: every Parser/Analyzer/Runtime error carries line and column
diagnostic renders source line + caret
edge tests: error on line 1, error on last line, empty file, multi-byte UTF-8 column offsets
no error path constructs a variant without a span

phases.title: Bounded call depth in the VM
phases.finding: src/vm.rs has no frame or recursion counter (grep for depth|stack|limit in vm.rs returns only a string-splitting depth at line 990). Infinite or deep recursion aborts the process with a Rust stack overflow instead of a clean Runtime error.
phases.goal: Add a configurable call-depth limit producing a catchable Runtime error.
accept: MAX_CALL_DEPTH constant, default 1000, overridable by env/flag
infinite recursion -> RuntimeError, process exit code 1, no abort
deep-but-legal recursion at depth 999 still succeeds
mutual recursion across two functions also bounded
error message names the function and the depth

phases.title: Numeric edge semantics
phases.finding: Value::Number is f64 with no documented policy for division by zero, NaN, or Infinity. `say` of NaN/Inf (value.rs:21-27) is undefined behaviour to a reader.
phases.goal: Define and implement total numeric semantics.
accept: x/0 and x%0 produce a Runtime error (decided and documented in SPEC.md)
NaN and Infinity cannot enter Value::Number silently
int overflow past 2^53 documented
0/0, 1/0, -1/0, -0.0, NaN.compare, sqrt(-1) all have defined tested outcomes
display of every non-finite value is specified

phases.title: Out-of-bounds and type errors are errors, never panics
phases.finding: Direct `Value` indexing and field access are not proven panic-free across all value shapes.
phases.goal: Prove and enforce total indexing and field access.
accept: index -1, index len, index 999 on a list -> Runtime error
field access on Number/Text/List -> Runtime error, not panic
missing record key returns a defined value (decided + documented) or errors
nested path a at 0 at 0 with a short inner list -> error
no `unwrap()`/`panic!`/direct index survives on a user-reachable path

phases.title: Lexer robustness: malformed and non-ASCII input
phases.finding: src/lexer.rs returns `Error::Lexer(String)`. Untested: unterminated strings, CRLF, BOM, NUL bytes, invalid UTF-8 file reads.
phases.goal: Every byte sequence produces either a correct token stream or a spanned lexer error.
accept: unterminated string -> spanned error
CRLF and lone CR handled
BOM stripped, not tokenized as an identifier
invalid UTF-8 file -> Io error, not panic
NUL and control chars rejected with column
emoji / CJK / RTL / combining marks inside strings round-trip

phases.title: Parser hardening: empty file, stray tokens, deep nesting
phases.finding: No evidence of tests for empty input, EOF mid-construct, or pathological nesting depth.
phases.goal: Parser never panics and never loops forever.
accept: empty file, whitespace-only, comment-only all parse to an empty Program
unclosed `end`, unclosed string, stray operator, unclosed bracket -> spanned Parser error
1000-deep nested list literal -> bounded error or success, no stack overflow
parse is O(n) on a 100k-token input (add a bench)

phases.title: Closure capture and lexical scoping
phases.finding: Value::Function(String, Vec<String>) stores only a name and parameter names (value.rs:13) — there is no captured environment. Nested functions and recursion over closures are therefore unsound or unimplemented.
phases.goal: Make function values carry a captured environment, or document and enforce that closures are unsupported with a clean error.
accept: decide: real closures OR explicit unsupported-error
shadowing, capture-by-value vs by-reference decided and documented
3+ nested scope depth tested
mutual recursion tested

phases.title: Object model: inheritance and method dispatch
phases.finding: Value::Object(String, HashMap<String,Value>) flattens everything; parser.rs supports a parent reference but the runtime model for it is unproven.
phases.goal: One coherent object model, tested.
accept: inheritance resolves method lookup in a defined order
field shadowing defined and documented
extending a frozen/nested object tested
cycle in the parent chain -> clean error, no infinite loop

phases.title: Bounded loops and interruptible execution
phases.finding: `for … times N` and `while` (if present) have no iteration cap and no cancellation hook, so a runaway loop cannot be stopped or tested.
phases.goal: Every loop is bounded and interruptible.
accept: MAX_ITERATIONS with a clean Runtime error on exceed
step budget so a test harness can bound a program
edge tests: 0 iterations, max iterations, max+1
infinite loop is testable and terminates

phases.title: Standard library: real filesystem and process modules
phases.finding: stdlib.rs exposes files/time/json/csv/network but there is no test coverage and no isolated temp-dir discipline.
phases.goal: Make stdlib testable and total.
accept: all fs functions tested against a per-test temp dir
missing file, permission denied, path with spaces, path traversal all defined
json.parse/stringify round-trip incl. nested, unicode, escapes, empty containers
csv.parse handles quotes, embedded commas, CRLF, ragged rows
network module has a documented timeout and is disabled in tests

phases.title: Formatter must be idempotent and lossless
phases.finding: src/formatter.rs (431 lines) has zero tests. `rb format --check` compares trimmed strings, so trailing-whitespace and newline differences pass.
phases.goal: format(format(x)) == format(x) for every corpus file, and format never changes semantics.
accept: idempotence property test over examples/ + tests/
format then parse gives an equivalent AST for every example
--check compares exactly, including trailing newline
formatter preserves comments

phases.title: Linter must not produce false positives
phases.finding: src/linter.rs (257 lines) has zero tests; it reports `errors` that make `rb lint` exit 1.
phases.goal: Linter output is trustworthy.
accept: zero false positives across examples/ and tests/
every rule has a positive and a negative test
rule for shadowing, unused variable, unused import, missing end
lint never panics on malformed source

phases.title: Language server / editor support scaffolding
phases.finding: tooling/vscode/README.md and tooling/repl/README.md are placeholders only.
phases.goal: A grammar file + LSP skeleton so tooling can attach.
accept: TextMate grammar covers the keyword set
diagnostics surface phase-005 spanned errors
no build step required for the grammar to be valid

phases.title: Bytecode format and disassembler (bootstrap S1a)
phases.finding: Redblue is tree-walking only; there is no bytecode representation to bootstrap toward.
phases.goal: Define a stable, versioned bytecode format plus `rb compile` and `rb dis`.
accept: docs/BYTECODE.md specifies the format, version, and encoding
rb compile emits .rbc for every examples/*.rb
rb dis round-trips and output is deterministic
unknown opcode version -> clean error

phases.title: Bytecode virtual machine (bootstrap S1b)
phases.finding: No bytecode execution path exists.
phases.goal: `rb vm file.rbc` executes bytecode with the same observable behaviour as the tree-walker.
accept: differential test: tree-walk vs bytecode produce identical output for a >=200 program corpus
identical error kinds and messages
step budget and call depth enforced in the bytecode VM too
no native stack overflow path

phases.title: Differential + property test harness
phases.finding: No differential or property testing infrastructure exists; this is what makes S3 provable.
phases.goal: A corpus-driven differential runner plus a property-test generator.
accept: corpus/ of >=200 .rb programs, each with an expected-output file
random program generator with a seed, reproducible
shrinker prints a minimal failing program
wired into cargo test

phases.title: Write the Redblue compiler in Redblue (bootstrap S2)
phases.finding: The self-hosted path does not exist yet.
phases.goal: A lexer+parser+code generator for Redblue, written in Redblue, under bootstrap/.
accept: bootstrap/compiler.rb is itself valid Redblue and passes rb lint
running it under the Rust rb on the corpus produces .rbc files
output is byte-identical to the Rust rb compile for the whole corpus
no Rust-only fast path is reachable from this path

phases.title: Self-hosting fixed point (bootstrap S3)
phases.finding: S2 exists but nothing proves it can build itself.
phases.goal: stage1.rbc and stage2.rbc are byte-identical.
accept: rb vm stage1.rbc -> stage2.rbc, byte-identical to stage1.rbc over the corpus
the fixed-point check runs in CI on every push
three consecutive runs produce identical bytes (determinism)
documented in docs/BOOTSTRAP.md

phases.title: Ship the self-hosted compiler as rb (bootstrap S4)
phases.finding: Final rung.
phases.goal: The released binary is produced by Redblue itself.
accept: release pipeline builds rb via the stage2 compiler
the resulting rb passes the full four-gate suite
bootstrap instructions are reproducible from a clean checkout
a rollback path to the Rust compiler is documented and tested

phases.title: Implement `constant`, or fix the module that assumes it
phases.finding: modules/MathUtils.rb:4 uses `constant PI to 3.14159`, but `constant` is absent from the keyword table in src/lexer.rs (the 49 keywords include `give`/`back` but not `constant`). `rb run modules/MathUtils.rb` fails with `ParserError: Expected function name`. This is recorded in rbops/baseline.json and currently only WARNS.
phases.goal: Decide whether redblue has module-level constants, then make modules/MathUtils.rb run.
accept: the decision is written into SPEC.md and docs/GRAMMAR.md
rb run modules/MathUtils.rb exits 0
the entry is removed from rbops/baseline.json
edge tests: duplicate constant name, constant reassignment, constant used before declaration, constant shadowed by a local
